interpretation.established: Removing the stable-prior A/B residual parameterization and the global q_pi scalar cap is insufficient under a parameter-only warm-start: the absolute compiler still converges to a low-energy, nearly shared update.
interpretation.implementation_localization: Compiler address embeddings were present in value tokens and the constant target/rank query was added directly before the factor heads; privileged factor tokens also received constant owner/rank embeddings. These paths let numeric addresses write a nearly task-independent LoRA without preserving Program content.
interpretation.expert_contract_gap: The segment inherited functional_start_task_visits=228, so all 38 updates optimized BA/factor coordinates and locality before any successful-policy functional response. The expert review explicitly requires policy-response, behavior/support and progress objectives rather than raw A/B reconstruction as the Stage 1 target.
interpretation.claim_boundary: The result rejects absolute coordinates plus parameter-only warm-start. It does not reject a content-address-separated, policy-functional privileged Program/compiler because that mechanism was not trained in this segment.

decision.next_interface: Separate compiler addresses from Program values, remove query-to-output and q_pi address shortcuts, and enable successful-policy functional response from the first update while retaining low-weight canonical/BA warm-start terms.
